Long ago one of your blood passed through the Flames of Asuryan and was left burnt, and you have borne the scorn of that legacy all your life. You never imagined you would get the chance to walk through the flames yourself, but you emerged unscathed and were crowned, and overnight your whole house is seen anew. To wear the Phoenix Crown would be legacy enough, but you will be remembered as the greatest of your line!
To the future of our house!

It has long been the custom for the ruler of Bretonnia to hold court in their own dukedom, to bolster the standing of their house. Your new court asks whether you will move the capital of the realm.
